name: soundings-app-interface
description: Take soundings before you ship an app-interface deployment. Point it at a Red Hat app-interface MR and it resolves the compare URLs from the newest devtools-bot Diffs comment, runs one soundings analysis across all of them together - one clear release verdict, with compound risks across repositories caught - annotates the report with app-interface's override-justification and feedback conventions, and offers to post it back to the MR as a new comment under your own identity. Red Hat internal: requires the soundings plugin (0.6.0 or later), a GITLAB_TOKEN for the app-interface GitLab host, and VPN access.
